name: Ahmad Nameh
bio: Ahmad Nameh is the Co-Founder of Alphabyte Solutions Inc. and head of its Data Readiness practice — the foundation every Alphabyte AI engagement is built on. With a decade of hands-on experience across the full data lifecycle, Ahmad leads a team of 10 specialists turning fragmented operational data into AI-ready environments for clients across the US and Canada.

A graduate of the University of Toronto's Commerce program, Ahmad has built Alphabyte's data and analytics practice into the firm's largest delivery arm. He is also co-founder of Parlawatch AI — featured in Maclean's and the University of Toronto Magazine — and MailSmart, an AI-powered direct mail optimization tool for Shopify merchants.
